input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Polish: fix the lowest-scoring flagship in the 2026-11-11 Lighthouse report (wall-framing-takeoff, perf 83, CLS 0.084)

errors.what: lighthouse.mjs failed every page with a chrome-launcher checkReady error while TMPDIR was the long scratchpad path
errors.fix: used a short TMPDIR (/tmp/claude-0/t); noted in platform/pages/README.md

errors.what: the first post description was 174 characters and failed 7 site-build tests (limit 160)
errors.fix: shortened it to 142 and re-ran the failing files

errors.what: the first reservation rule did nothing on wall-framing-takeoff: the venture declares [hidden]{display:none !important}
errors.fix: added !important, limited the rule to screen, and checked the result with layout-shift entries

errors.what: the post first said Google calls CLS over 0.1 poor; Google's bands are good at 0.1 or less and poor over 0.25

doc_friction.issue: Its header documents only Lantern scores. Lantern's LCP counts every request that finished before the observed paint, so it scored modulepreload as a 1.9 s first-paint cost that real throttling did not show. Added --throttling=devtools and a README note.
It says prompts/runs/ 'stay unowned', but .github/CODEOWNERS lists /prompts/runs/. One of the two is stale.

deviations.why: Its first suggestion was to cut what the first screen waits on, and Lighthouse pointed at the 43 modulepreload links. Real-throttling runs showed removing them would slow the tool by about 0.3 s, so I fixed the measured layout shift instead.
deviations.did: kept the preloads; fixed the CLS causes in the shared chrome
deviations.result: median CLS 0.113 to 0.002 on 14 sampled tool pages; wall-framing-takeoff Lighthouse perf 83 to 86

notes: Before/after with Lighthouse 12.8.2 mobile on the 16 default pages in the same session: CLS on 8 flagships went from 0.018-0.084 to <=0.003; accessibility and SEO stayed 100 everywhere. Page CLS sample (Playwright, 412 px) on every 12th saved-bids page: median 0.113 to 0.002, worst 0.253 to 0.007. Tests: node --test 'platform/pages/*.test.mjs': 1,507 tests, 1,499 passing; the 7 failures were all the post description, re-run green after the fix (see PR). The after numbers were taken on the local dist with regenerated pf-*.css/pf-rates.js and the rates status patched into the sampled pages the way the build now writes it, not on a full rebuild.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: front-end engineer: Lighthouse runs and trace reading, root-causing two CLS sources across shared chrome, CSS fixes, regression tests, report and post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
